title: Hikarigama Wood and Soda Firings
summary: Hikarigama in Elkton, Oregon offers periodic wood and soda firings in a traditional anagama kiln. Potters bring their work and participate in multi-day loading and firing.
how_to_join: Unknown; contact information not provided on the pages.
source_quote: I had my first experience firing with wood about eight years ago when I began attending firings in Elkton, Oregon at Hiroshi Ogawa's kiln, Hikarigama.
evidence_sentence: Jennifer Long describes attending periodic firings at Hikarigama where potters work together over several days to load and fire the kiln.
evidence_quote: The camaraderie of working with other potters to load and fire the kiln over the course of several days was exciting, mysterious and addictive.
